reading.action: Return to the brazier by the water, call it done for the day and sleep; on waking, check the Furnace-heart charging in the coals to see whether it has reached its limit.

rest.note: Undisturbed sleep on the threat-cleared floor (swept t51-52), banked by the brazier. Full restore + the lingering t45 burns finish healing. HP 70->106, Focus 64->110, Stamina 24->68.

check_core_limit_read.note: NAT 1 / FUMBLE on the limit-read. His fire-sense slips off the core; the reading is muddled and leans 'still hungry / not yet full', so he comes away UNABLE to confirm it has capped and (mistakenly, low-confidence) believing it has not. GROUND TRUTH (internal, NOT player-facing): the Furnace-heart DID reach its limit overnight — it is full, banked, holding a steady charge, drawing no more. His belief diverges from the truth — track this. No XP (fumble), no draw, no tick.

reading.result: RESTED — full recovery (HP/Focus/Stamina to max; t45 burns healed). CORE READ FUMBLED — he could not confirm the Furnace-heart's limit and leans (wrongly) toward 'still filling'; GROUND TRUTH is that it is already at its cap (internal only — fog of war holds). No XP, no expenditure, no affinity tick. Fully restored, uncertain about the core, the way up still open and unclimbed. STOP at his decision point. NO assumed next action. NO Tower reset.
